item.description: Nollywood actress Bimbo Ademoye has shared two strict conditions before agreeing to marry her colleague, Timini Egbuson, sparking reactions online.The revelation came after skitmaker Kamo State posted a loved-up video of the two actors on his Instagram page. item.title: Former South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol Sentenced to Life Imprisonment Over Martial Law Insurrection
